description: This file defines a React functional component 'ControlPopover' that manages a popover UI element with dynamic placement based on element visibility and viewport position. It includes utility functions for container element retrieval and visibility ratio calculation, and handles various lifecycle effects for event listeners and observers.

classes.name: ControlPopover
classes.description: A React functional component that renders a customizable popover with dynamic placement and visibility management.

methods.name: getSectionContainerElement
methods.description: Retrieves the last child element of the container with ID 'controlSections'.

methods.name: getElementVisibilityRatio
methods.description: Calculates the vertical and horizontal visibility ratios of a given HTMLElement relative to the viewport.
